question.text: A coil of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn></math> turns and area <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> is rotated at half a revolution per second and is placed in uniform magnetic field of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>01</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math> perpendicular to axis of rotation of the coil. The maximum voltage generated in the coil is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><mi>β</mi></mfrac></math> volt. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi></math> is ______.

solution.text:
Time taken for one complete revolution = time period =2 s.

Therefore, ω=2πT=π rad s-1

Now flux, ϕ=NABcos(ωt)

Therefore, induced EMF ε=-dϕdt=NABωsin(ωt)

The maximum voltage generated, εmax=NABω

=200×0.2×0.01×π

=4π10=2π5 volt

Hence, β=5.
